events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Tampa Bay scored three times in the first period, Darren Raddysh scored a pair of third-period goals, and the Lightning coasted to a 6-1 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning snap losing streak with dominant 6-1 win over Canadiens

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Cody Glass scored the tiebreaking goal on a wrist shot with 7:36 remaining, and the New Jersey Devils beat the Ottawa Senators 4-3 on Tuesday night to snap a five-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cody Glass scores tiebreaking goal and Devils beat Senators 4-3 to snap 5-game skid

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Emil Heineman scored in the fourth round of the shootout after New York allowed a tying goal in the closing seconds of regulation, and the Islanders beat the Vegas Golden Knights 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Emil Heineman scores in 4th round of shootout and Islanders beat Golden Knights 5-4

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Travis Konecny got his 500th NHL point and Dan Vladar only had to make 17 saves as the Philadelphia Flyers beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konecny gets 500th NHL point in Flyers' 4-1 win over Sharks

headlines.description: — Beckett Sennecke scored a short-handed goal with 1 second remaining to force overtime, Leo Carlsson scored in the shootout and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-3 on Tuesday night for their fifth win in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beckett Sennecke beats the buzzer to force OT and Ducks win shootout to beat Penguins 4-3

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Eric Robinson ended a 10-game stretch without a goal by breaking a third-period tie and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes scored 3 goals in the third period to beat the Blue Jackets 4-1

events.name: Boston Bruins at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Mark Kastelic and Fraser Minten scored two goals each and the Boston Bruins rallied to beat the St. Louis Blues 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bruins rally to beat Blues 5-2 with two goals each from Kastelic and Minten

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson scored his team-leading 19th goal and Mikko Rantanen had three assists as the Dallas Stars extended their point streak to 11 games Tuesday night with a 4-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars down Jets 4-3 to push point streak to 11 games

headlines.description: — Alex Tuch scored 33 seconds into overtime and the Buffalo Sabres snapped a three-game losing streak with a 4-3 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Tuch's overtime goal lifts Sabres over Oilers, snapping losing streak

headlines.description: — Ryan O'Reilly scored the only goal in a shootout to give the Nashville Predators a 4-3 victory over the Colorado Avalanche on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: O'Reilly scores shootout winner as Predators defeat Avalanche 4-3
